title: I Let the Reserved-Assault-Bike Scanner Catch the Coach Who Sat on Mine

parts.text: I scanned the reserved assault bike at 6:13 a.m. and coach Tess was already on the seat. The screen said MY NAME. I was twenty-nine, member, standing in a bay that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the scan, the seat, and her leftover timer. Then I asked for the reservation log. The desk moved Tess to an open bike and dated the override. I keep the scan still. The bay finally knows a reservation from a leftover timer.

social.video_title: The coach sat on my reserved assault bike — Part 1/1
social.description: Reserved scan, leftover timer, a seat that said my name. The desk dated the override. Would you have asked for the reservation log?
